title: Derive mutable lifecycle component invariants from append-only rows
failure_signature: The first post-M16 detailed validator passed forty-four of forty-six checks but two checks still hard-coded older x2-negative and preferred-method counts.
trigger_preconditions: append-only negative and Method Flow rows can grow during validation
the validator carries fixed historical component counts
the total receipt has already been updated
candidate_workaround: Keep the frozen inherited, x1, and synthetic baselines explicit, but derive the growing x2 row count and Method Flow state histogram from the append-only collections themselves.
recurrence_guard: Use fixed counts only for frozen inputs; for lifecycle-grown collections validate row-count equality, balanced witnesses, unique identifiers, and all-preferred state dynamically.
rollback: If a derived invariant disagrees with the underlying rows, preserve the validator failure and do not coerce either side.
scope_boundary: Derived invariants prevent stale-count failures only; they do not relax the fixed source, gate, or substantive evidence requirements.
